fix: Drop the Vec clone: RenderObjectId is Copy, so iterate by index. Replace the `let materialized = ...clone();` binding with `let child_count = self.render_live(id, "sliver viewport render must remain live").children.len().min(sliver_layout.children.len());` and in the loop read `let child = self.render_live(id, "sliver viewport render must remain live").children[index];` paired with `let layout = &sliver_layout.children[index];` (same truncation as the original zip).

Stop cloning the whole SliverViewportLayout (children Vec) on every shrink-wrap publication. Have publish_sliver_attempt store the layout once in `last_published` (move it in) and have callers read the current layout from `last_published` by reference, or return the layout only where the caller needs an owned value. Remove `layout: layout.clone()`.

Avoid a fresh Vec per inline-text layout: keep a reusable placeholder scratch buffer on WidgetTree, `let mut placeholders = std::mem::take(&mut self.placeholder_scratch); placeholders.clear(); if let Some(inline) = inline { placeholders.extend_from_slice(&inline.placeholders); }`, and move it back into `self.placeholder_scratch` after the layout is produced.

ChildOffsets already implements FromIterator<Offset>, which keeps one or two offsets inline. Remove the intermediate Vec: delete `.collect::<Vec<_>>()` and `.into()` so the chain ends in `.collect()` directly.

Check the decoration before building the run, so the common undecorated field allocates nothing: `if !style.decoration.is_some_and(|decoration| !decoration.is_empty()) { return Arc::from([]); }` (or a shared empty Arc), then build `whole` only in the decorated case: `Arc::from([incular_text::StyledTextRun { text: display.to_owned(), style: style.clone(), range: 0..display.len() }])`.
